svg.title: Certificate issuance and renewal
svg.desc: Cloudflare DNS-01 validates the private hostname without opening an HTTP challenge endpoint.

g.text: Cloudflare DNS-01 validates the private hostname without opening an HTTP challenge endpoint.
Self-checks use public DNS-over-HTTPS and recursive-nameservers-only to avoid split-DNS answers.
API token: SOPS-encrypted in Git; delivered through stdin with no_log; stored as a Kubernetes Secret.
Preserve the ACME account and TLS Secrets. Deleting them can consume certificate-authority rate limits.
